credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data; RTC hosted by Microsoft Planetary Computer
method: WGS84 2400 m square centered on the published Earth window; 120x120 nearest-neighbor samples. Later paired gamma0 converted to dB. Pair difference computed after a 5x5 local mean in linear power (approximately 100 m), then 10 log10(new/old). Null means missing or insufficient valid pixels. The two acquisitions share platform, polarization, relative orbit and orbit direction.
caveats: The 3 dB threshold is an exploratory surface-change screen, not a validated hazard detector.
Backscatter responds to surface moisture, roughness, incidence geometry and processing; it does not measure cave depth or void geometry.
The output grid is approximately aligned to the regional DEM window and is not a rover-scale survey.
A quiet pixel does not establish safety; a highlighted pixel does not establish a hazard.
